name: review-bot
description: Model-agnostic pull-request review bot: a cheap system-1 triage picks the tier, a strong model reviews against the repo's own protocol, the findings land on the PR as a review, and an approval follows only when the gate allows it.

scripts.build: bun build src/action.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
